node.title: Bound sparse quotient circuits in every dimension on the K'=14..21 ladder
node.closure: generalized-MDS completion ceiling, equality-carrier structure, and full-rank deletion count
node.statement: Let V<=F[X]_<K have dimension ten, empty common zero set, and quotient dimension q=K-10. For support c<=5, q completions of one independent deletion force every sparse circuit into one carrier of size at most q+4; otherwise each deletion has at most q-1 completions and the exact deletion count applies. This holds in particular for every official row K'=14..21.
